brief:
Palestine News Network's programme Al-Makshouf, presented by journalist Sara Rizk, examined the destruction of Gaza's agricultural sector and the challenges facing farmers in the territory, the Palestine News Network reported. The episode highlighted the impact of damage to farming infrastructure and livelihoods across the strip.

Details on specific agricultural initiatives and the scope of destruction were not elaborated in the available summary.

title: Al-Makshouf examines Gaza's agricultural collapse and farmer hardship
